source_critical_text: Saints-Hebrew-Critical-Text (Studio v10 Stage 1 a0d022c1; MAM Aleppo + WLC Leningrad)
followup_note_fix_scope: Note-attachment & cross-reference fixes only (0 verse-text changes vs e2f4b634)
strict_honesty_policy: Only individually named verses or explicitly documented short contextual ranges verified against adopted Hebrew/Aramaic in existing reviewer logs, verdicts, notes, and blind-review records are counted as documented_contextual_read. Unattributed aggregate claims, batch edition-wide replacements, wide speech-frame boundary scans, and standalone English-only Pass 3 reads are reported separately and NEVER counted toward documented_contextual_read.

editorial_status_separate_from_evidence.note: Editorial disposition status is strictly separated from evidence classification (documented_contextual_read vs automated_screening_only).

corr24_edition_wide_standardization_edit.note: Central edition-wide lexical/note standardization passes (hesed -> loyal love, zera -> seed, yam-suf -> Sea of Reeds, etc.); excluded from documented_contextual_read.

pass3_english_only_reads.note: Zero Hebrew/Aramaic source inspection (standalone English isolation); excluded from source-checked documented_contextual_read.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claimed_scope: All 23,167 English verse units (52 parallel reviewers covering ~450 verses each against MT Hebrew/Aramaic)
unattributed_aggregate_claims.reason_not_attributed: Only changed verses (581 verse-review rows + 88 structural rows) and named open items were logged individually; unchanged verses have no per-verse read receipt or reviewer sign-off log.
unattributed_aggregate_claims.disposition: Individual unlogged verses remain classified as automated_screening_only.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claimed_scope: All 5 Biblical Aramaic pericopes (269 verses — '100% Line-by-Line Read')
unattributed_aggregate_claims.reason_not_attributed: Original Pass 1 summary mis-stated pericope subtotals (Ezra 4:8-6:18 as 67 instead of 52; Dan 2:4-7:28 as 185 instead of 200) and recorded no verse-by-verse contextual read log for unmentioned Aramaic verses.
unattributed_aggregate_claims.disposition: Only the 33 Aramaic verses with individually documented source-checked records are classified as documented_contextual_read; the remaining 236 remain automated_screening_only.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claimed_scope: Low-alignment outliers (83 vv) & length-ratio outliers (35 vv) — 'All 118 manually read against MT Hebrew'
unattributed_aggregate_claims.reason_not_attributed: Individual verse references for the 118 outlier verses were not saved to a file.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.reason_not_attributed: Reported as aggregate pattern/sweep totals; only individually named verses (e.g., 2 Sam 18:20, Ruth 3:17, Ps 16:1/45:1/60:1/74:1/78:1/69:1/80:1) have per-verse records.
unattributed_aggregate_claims.disposition: Only explicitly named verses enter documented_contextual_read; aggregate sweep totals remain automated_screening_only.

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claimed_scope: Editorial coverage totals: Pass 1 verified=22,906; Pass 2 verified=23,008 -> 22,972 -> 22,971 (disputed=242, unverified=0)

unattributed_aggregate_claims.claimed_scope: Multi-chapter speech-frame quotation verification across Exod 21:1-23:33, Exod 25:1-30:10, Lev 1-3/4-5/6:17-7:21/25-26, Num 28:1-29:39, Job 28 & 30-31
